meta.name: seo
meta.description: SEO best practices for the Grida project across Next.js pages, blog posts, and documentation. Covers Next.js metadata API, Open Graph / Twitter cards, sitemaps, image search optimization, structured data (JSON-LD), Docusaurus frontmatter, and content writing for search. Use when creating or editing public-facing pages under editor/app/(www), writing blog posts, authoring docs, or reviewing SEO-related metadata. Trigger phrases: "SEO", "metadata", "sitemap", "open graph", "og image", "meta tags", "search ranking", "structured data", "JSON-LD".
